WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT
    o.lunarstage,
    t.observstation,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes AS t
  INNER JOIN observatories AS o
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage, t.observstation
), phase_stats AS (
  SELECT
    lunarstage,
    AVG(station_avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
    COUNT(*) AS station_count
  FROM station_averages
  GROUP BY lunarstage
)
SELECT
  lunarstage,
  avg_bandusagepct,
  station_count,
  CAST(station_count AS REAL) / SUM(station_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM phase_stats;
